+    level: usertypes.JsLogLevel,
+    source: str,
+    line: int,
+    msg: str,
+) -> bool:
+    """Show an eligible JavaScript message in the UI and return whether shown."""
+    levels_by_source = config.cache['content.javascript.log_message.levels'] or {}
+    if not any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(source, pattern) and level.name in levels
+               for pattern, levels in levels_by_source.items()):
+        return False
+
+    excludes = config.cache['content.javascript.log_message.excludes'] or {}
+    if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(source, pattern) and

+           for pattern, messages in excludes.items()):
+        return False
+
